title: Dream of home
creator_credit: John Fitchen and Michael Eddowes Films
brief_description: A short survey of the life of the well known British poet, Rupert Brooke, who was killed in the first World War. His poems dealt with life, love and above all his love of England. The famous poem “The old vicarage, Grantchester” is spoken and illustrated by views of the countryside, buildings and people of England.
